summary_en: This Phase 1/2 study tests sacituzumab govitecan given together with cisplatin in people with platinum-sensitive recurrent ovarian or endometrial cancer. Cisplatin is given by IV at 70 mg/m2, and sacituzumab govitecan is given at 7.5 mg/kg or 5 mg/kg; how often and for how long are not stated. The record does not state a primary outcome measure; its stated goal is to find the optimal dose of sacituzumab govitecan to use with cisplatin.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/2 evalúa sacituzumab govitecan combinado con cisplatino en personas con cáncer de ovario o endometrio recurrente sensible al platino. El cisplatino se administra por vía intravenosa a 70 mg/m2, y el sacituzumab govitecan se administra a 7.5 mg/kg o 5 mg/kg; la frecuencia y la duración no se indican. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; su objetivo declarado es encontrar la dosis óptima de sacituzumab govitecan para usar con cisplatino.
who_for: Confirmed epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, peritoneal, or endometrial cancer that has recurred
Cancer progressed more than 6 months after the last platinum-based chemotherapy
WHO performance status 0-1 and life expectancy of at least 12 weeks
Measurable disease on CT or PET/CT scan
not_for: Prior sacituzumab govitecan, irinotecan, or Trop-2 antibody drug conjugate treatment
Known active brain metastases or carcinomatous meningitis
Active hepatitis B, hepatitis C, HIV, or other uncontrolled serious conditions
